Messages.Author: lip
Messages.Body:
When can the bleed reduction effect of Illusory Resources be used ?  During the action, before Andre LeRoux has a chance to his his ability ? When the bleed would be successful, when no modifier can be played to augment it again afterwards ?

Illusory Resources

+1 stealth action. Unique.

Put this card in play with 1 counter. During your unlock phase, a ready vampire with Chimerstry k you control can move 1 blood to this card. You can burn X counters from this card to reduce a bleed against you by X.

As above, but this card is put in play with 2 counters.

Andre LeRoux

Camarilla: If a vampire you control would successfully bleed, you can reduce the bleed amount by 1 to give Andre +2 bleed this turn.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> lip wrote:
> When can the bleed reduction effect of Illusory Resources be used ?
>
Before action resolution.

> lip wrote:
> During the action, before Andre LeRoux has a chance to his his ability ?
>
Yes, before the vampire "would successfully bleed", that is before resolution of the action.

> lip wrote:
> When the bleed would be successful, when no modifier can be played to augment it again afterwards ?
>
You need to reduce the bleed before resolution of the action.
